title: El Fantasma de Jolene Cranley-Evans

observationPoint.tip: Keep about 40 meters distance on the southern ridge with a sniper rifle to avoid startling her.

description: Between 23:00 and 0:00 every night, the floating apparition of a woman in white appears above a flat rock on Mount Gordo. When approached, she vanishes into thin air, leaving the word 'JOCK' written in fresh blood on the rock.
lore: In March 1978, Jolene Cranley-Evans fell to her death from the cliffs of Mount Gordo. Her husband, John 'Jock' Cranley (a famous stuntman and 2013 candidate for Governor of San Andreas), wanted to move to Los Santos to pursue his career in Vinewood, while Jolene wanted to stay behind to care for her parents. Jock pushed her over the cliff. Despite being arrested, police concluded it was an accidental fall due to lack of evidence.
mechanics: Appears exactly between 23:00 and 00:00 in-game time every night.
If the player gets within 30-40 meters, the ghost instantly vanishes.
To observe her in detail, look through a sniper rifle scope or phone camera from a distance.
After vanishing, the word 'JOCK' written in fresh blood is revealed on the rock.
Standing nearby in silence during midnight reveals ghostly wails and eerie whispers.
clues: In-game website: On www.whokilledleonorajohnson.com, a 1978 newspaper clipping titled 'Blood on the Rocks' covers the case.
Radio and billboards: During his 2013 gubernatorial campaign, Jock Cranley campaigns actively across San Andreas ignoring his past.
Photography: Photographing the ghost was later featured in GTA Online Halloween events.
